description: Known level disagreements between the loc.txt parse and the PDF layout extraction. compare-extractions.ts fails on any disagreement not listed here, and on any listed entry that no longer disagrees. status "confirmed": the text level was checked against the rendered page and the printed totals; the PDF's typography is irregular, the values are kept as printed and each row is listed in canonical/issues.json (printed-typography-inconsistency).

differences.name: BANDEM RIVE GAUCHE
differences.verdict: text level is right; the typography heuristic is misled by an irregularly printed row

evidence.typography: PDF p228: printed at the canton indent (same as NKONDJOCK VILLE and MBANG) but in regular weight and without the canton shading.
evidence.totals: Printed total 3581 = Σ of the 11 rows below it (ABINYAM … TOUMBASSALA); NKONDJOCK VILLE 4232 = Σ of its own 8 rows; NKONDJOCK 17428 = 4232 + 3581 + 9615 (MBANG).

differences.name: MBESA
differences.verdict: text level is right; the typography heuristic is misled by an irregularly printed row

evidence.typography: PDF p298: bold and shaded like the cantons BELO TOWN and KOM, but set slightly left of them (x=102.7 vs 107.3), still well right of the arrondissement row (x=98.2). The layout heuristic's x<103 cut-off reads it as an arrondissement row.
evidence.totals: Printed total 5621 = its single village MBESA (5621); BELO 40757 = 10130 (BELO TOWN) + 25006 (KOM) + 5621. BELO already has its arrondissement row on the same page.

evidence.totals: Printed total 9959 = Σ of the 10 rows below it (FIANGO … YER); JAKIRI 47022 = 9959 + 495 (DZEKWA) + 36568 (JAKIRI RURAL). As a village it would precede the first canton.
